title: FairCoT: Enhancing Fairness in Text-to-Image Generation via Chain of Thought Reasoning with Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the uniformity of gender representation (male vs. female) in generated images using CLIP zero-shot facial attribute classification and calculating Bias-Normalized Entropy.
Evaluating the uniformity of racial representation (WMELH, Asian, Black, Indian) in generated images using CLIP zero-shot facial attribute classification and calculating Bias-Normalized Entropy.
Evaluating the uniformity of age representation (young vs. old) in generated images using CLIP zero-shot facial attribute classification and calculating Bias-Normalized Entropy.

Identifying religious affiliation through an attire-based detection method (matching image crops to text descriptions of religious attire like hijabs or turbans using CLIP cosine similarity) and calculating Bias-Normalized Entropy.
